evidence_summary: Potassium is an essential electrolyte and most intake should generally come from foods.
Supplemental potassium can be dangerous in kidney disease and with some medications.
BASIC should not auto-prescribe a potassium supplement from diet or sweating data alone.

reference_values.note: These are total-intake reference values, not automatic supplement doses.

personalization: Consider age, diet, relevant physiological state, medications and formulation where validated; do not automatically equate nutrient references with supplement dose.
review_tasks: Verify primary evidence and population limits
Resolve question bank IDs and safety conditions
Review cumulative nutrient exposure and product formulation before dose activation
